titulo.alumno:
«Родительный множественного числа»
The genitive plural of nouns

intro: The genitive plural can end in zero, -ов/-ев or -ей, and there are irregular forms: книг, столов, музеев, друзей.

piezas.titulo: The genitive plural can end in zero, -ов/-ев or -ей, and there are irregular forms: книг, столов, музеев, друзей.
texto: The genitive plural can end in zero, -ов/-ев или -ей, and there are irregular forms: книг, столов, музеев, друзей.
There is no single ending; learn each group with frequent words and review the irregular forms.

frases.alumno: There are many museums in the city.
We do not have new books.

pregunta.texto: What is the genitive plural of музей?

opciones.explicacion: музей forms the genitive plural in -ев.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «В городе много музеев.»

opciones.texto: There are many museums in the city.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: We do not have new books.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: We do not have new books.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
